goal: Acquire exact-ID DR3 source-property tags for retained4756EDR3source IDs without accessing proper-motion outcomes, preserving left-join missingness and outcome-blind strata

forbidden_array_access: Other outcome arrays during intake or stratum definition
source_id_input.identity: Unique int64, sorted decimal ASCII each followed by LF, no header
source_id_input.join: EDR3/DR3 same-source exact integer release join; no positional/probabilistic match

provider_limits.interpretation: Current provider upload limits, NOT a download cap

request.access: Anonymous ephemeral inline TAP_UPLOAD; no credentials
request.main_SQL: SELECT u.source_id AS retained_source_id,q.source_id AS qso_source_id,q.host_galaxy_detected,q.host_galaxy_flag,q.n_transits,q.classlabel_dsc_joint,q.vari_best_class_name,q.vari_best_class_score,q.vari_agn_membership_score,q.source_selection_flags FROM TAP_UPLOAD.ids4756 AS u LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.qso_candidates AS q ON u.source_id=q.source_id ORDER BY u.source_id
request.independent_count_SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_left,COUNT(q.source_id) AS n_matched FROM TAP_UPLOAD.ids4756 AS u LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.qso_candidates AS q ON u.source_id=q.source_id

validation.response: Parse complete VOTable, including trailing QUERY_STATUS; reject OVERFLOW/ERROR/truncation
validation.qso_rows: Every nonnull qso_source_id equals retained_source_id; no duplicate joins
validation.count: n_left=4756 and n_matched agrees with parsed main response
validation.preserve: Field masks and types; exact integer source IDs
validation.nonvariability: Never infer nonvariability from missing metadata
validation.semantic_consistency: Report inconsistencies without recoding source values
validation.packaging: Packaging metadata hash changes are not scientific failures; verify semantics and schema

outcome_blind_strata.future_primary_comparison: Host flags1–2 combined versus3; flags4–6/missing kept separately and excluded only from this comparison definition
variability: Each other nonnull individual class name retained separately
outcome_blind_strata.scores: Retain vari_best_class_score and vari_agn_membership_score without thresholds, propensity or probability interpretation; AGN membership score explicitly NOT probability
outcome_blind_strata.selection_bit1: Frame-rotator eligibility/use provenance only; never new filter
crosstabs: Host flag x module selection bits

storage.reserve_scope: At external cache only; not a blanket repository write gate
storage.compact_repository_artifacts: Size to actual available repository disk
storage.advisor_disk_observation: External2.48TB free, root203MB free; observation may change and must not be treated as guaranteed capacity

network_limits.retry: At most1retry per failed request, transient failure only; preserve first failure

outputs: Upload VOTable and canonical ID identity in external cache
Compact manifest/report/raw receipt/return in owned repository directory

future_downstream_not_current_task.freeze_after: Actual availability is known; no outcome-based stratum changes
future_downstream_not_current_task.model: Common spin nuisance B_i*omega + X_i*beta + I_host*X_i*delta
future_downstream_not_current_task.target: Full13interaction vector+STF+STF with covariance support and identifiable subspace
future_downstream_not_current_task.eligibility: Rank/support determines eligibility; no arbitrary quota or regrouping
future_downstream_not_current_task.interpretation: Association only, not causal centroid law or independent physical validation

functional_bundle.Pi: Existing law unchanged; no new calibrated population probability
